{{Top|leg}}
'''Ubiqtorate Man''' was the name given to the [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] assigned to a [[Garrison/Legends|garrison]]. The officer was in contact with the local [[Sector Plexus/Legends|Sector Plexus]], and provided the garrison with intelligence from local [[system cell]]s and [[Diplomatic Services]] [[Agent/Legends|agents]]. The Ubiqtorate Man was attached to the local [[sector branch]] and was usually assigned to head any [[Crisis]] branch established on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].<ref name="IG">{{JournalCite|12|Imperial Garrisons}}</ref>
